cases.title: Automated Competitor Analysis
cases.description: Automated Competitor Analysis: An LLM-powered agent takes a prompt to analyze a competitor, uses web search and data retrieval tools to collect information on products, pricing, partnerships, and announcements, then synthesizes a comprehensive competitive intelligence report with recommendations.
cases.rationale: One agent iteratively gathers external evidence with tools before synthesizing recommendations.

cases.title: End-to-End Invoice Processing
cases.description: End-to-End Invoice Processing: An agent ingests invoices and purchase orders in any format, extracts key information using multimodal models, validates details against ERP and inventory systems, creates transactions automatically, and routes exceptions for human review.
cases.rationale: Bounded ingest, extraction, validation, transaction, and exception-review stages form an ordered workflow.

cases.title: Context-Aware Customer Support Resolution
cases.description: Context-Aware Customer Support Resolution: A support agent reviews customer history, order data, product documentation, and previous tickets, executes approved actions such as refunds or shipment updates, and resolves cases with minimal human involvement.
cases.rationale: One agent selects and executes case-dependent actions with minimal human step selection.

cases.title: Autonomous Bug Resolution
cases.description: Autonomous Bug Resolution: A software engineering agent monitors CI/CD pipelines and production telemetry, identifies the likely root cause of failures, generates code fixes, runs tests, validates results, and submits a pull request for review.
cases.rationale: An autonomous engineering loop observes, diagnoses, acts, tests, and validates.

cases.title: Automated Lead Enrichment
cases.description: Automated Lead Enrichment: A sales agent researches inbound prospects across public and enterprise data sources, identifies decision makers, evaluates account fit, enriches CRM records, and drafts personalized outreach recommendations.
cases.rationale: One research agent gathers evidence, evaluates fit, updates CRM, and drafts recommendations.

cases.title: Clinical Notes Generation
cases.description: Clinical Notes Generation: A healthcare agent listens to physician-patient conversations, generates structured clinical documentation, captures medical observations, and drafts records for provider validation.
cases.rationale: Audio intake, structured documentation, observation capture, and provider validation are bounded stages.

cases.title: Contract Review and Risk Assessment
cases.description: Contract Review and Risk Assessment: A legal agent analyzes contracts against organizational policies, highlights risky clauses, identifies deviations from standard terms, and generates recommended redlines.
cases.rationale: Contract comparison, risk extraction, deviation analysis, and redline generation are bounded processing stages.

cases.title: Threat Investigation and Triage
cases.description: Threat Investigation and Triage: A cybersecurity agent reviews security alerts, correlates telemetry across multiple tools, determines attack severity, and recommends or executes predefined response actions.
cases.rationale: One agent observes, correlates, decides severity, and conditionally acts across tools.

cases.title: Executive Briefing Preparation
cases.description: Executive Briefing Preparation: An executive assistant agent gathers meeting notes, emails, CRM records, operational reports, and news updates to create concise executive briefings with actions and risks.
cases.rationale: One agent selects evidence from several systems and synthesizes actions and risks.

cases.title: Expense and Time Tracking Automation
cases.description: Expense and Time Tracking Automation: An agent reviews calendars, meetings, emails, and development activity to draft timesheets, categorize expenses, and prepare submissions for employee approval.
cases.rationale: Source review, drafting, categorization, submission, and employee approval are bounded stages.

cases.title: Product Launch Orchestration
cases.description: Product Launch Orchestration: Research agents analyze market trends, content agents create campaign materials, legal agents review messaging, sales agents prepare account strategies, and coordination agents manage launch readiness across functions.
cases.rationale: Five named specialist agent roles collaborate on launch readiness.

cases.title: Software Development Factory
cases.description: Software Development Factory: Planning agents generate requirements, coding agents write code, testing agents create and execute tests, security agents review vulnerabilities, and release agents prepare deployment packages.
cases.rationale: Five distinct software-delivery agent roles hand work across a factory.

cases.title: Customer Escalation Resolution Network
cases.description: Customer Escalation Resolution Network: Support agents gather case details, product agents analyze technical issues, billing agents review transaction history, and case management agents coordinate resolution and customer communications.
cases.rationale: Four named agent roles coordinate a customer escalation.

cases.title: Enterprise Research and Report Generation
cases.description: Enterprise Research and Report Generation: Research agents gather information from internal and external sources, analyst agents synthesize findings, writer agents draft reports, and reviewer agents validate quality and compliance.
cases.rationale: Research, analysis, writing, and review are assigned to four collaborating agent roles.

cases.title: Loan Processing Workflow
cases.description: Loan Processing Workflow: Document processing agents extract information from applications, risk agents perform credit evaluations, compliance agents check regulations, and approval agents prepare lending recommendations.
cases.rationale: Four named specialist agent roles collaborate despite workflow wording.

cases.title: Supply Chain Disruption Management
cases.description: Supply Chain Disruption Management: Monitoring agents detect disruptions, sourcing agents identify alternative suppliers, logistics agents optimize transportation routes, and planning agents update fulfillment schedules.
cases.rationale: Four supply-chain agent roles coordinate detection and response.

cases.title: Cybersecurity Threat Hunting
cases.description: Cybersecurity Threat Hunting: Detection agents monitor activity, investigation agents analyze attack paths, intelligence agents compare indicators against threat feeds, and remediation agents isolate affected systems.
cases.rationale: Four named security agent roles collaborate on hunting and remediation.

cases.title: Project Management Office Automation
cases.description: Project Management Office Automation: Planning agents maintain schedules, risk agents identify delivery concerns, reporting agents generate executive dashboards, and resource management agents recommend staffing adjustments.
cases.rationale: Four PMO agent roles maintain distinct responsibilities and coordinate recommendations.

cases.title: Healthcare Care Coordination
cases.description: Healthcare Care Coordination: Intake agents collect patient information, scheduling agents coordinate appointments, care management agents track treatment plans, and communication agents engage patients and providers.
cases.rationale: Four care-delivery agent roles coordinate patient and provider work.

cases.title: Agentic Document Processing Pipeline
cases.description: Agentic Document Processing Pipeline: Extraction agents read documents, classification agents categorize content, validation agents verify accuracy, and workflow agents route completed transactions to downstream systems.
cases.rationale: Four named agent roles collaborate inside the document pipeline.

cases.title: Self-Healing Cloud Infrastructure
cases.description: Self-Healing Cloud Infrastructure: Autonomous operations agents continuously monitor cloud environments, detect configuration drift or service degradation, execute corrective actions, validate system health, and document changes without human intervention.
cases.rationale: An autonomous observe-act-validate loop self-heals infrastructure without human intervention.

cases.title: Autonomous Security Operations Center (SOC)
cases.description: Autonomous Security Operations Center (SOC): Security agents continuously monitor telemetry, investigate suspicious activities, isolate compromised assets, block malicious activity, and verify remediation actions in real time.
cases.rationale: Continuous monitoring, action, and remediation verification form an autonomous loop.

cases.title: Autonomous Data Pipeline Management
cases.description: Autonomous Data Pipeline Management: Data agents monitor pipeline performance, detect failures and data quality issues, reroute workloads, optimize execution plans, and restore operations automatically.
cases.rationale: The system observes pipeline state, adapts execution, and restores operations automatically.

cases.title: Continuous Compliance Monitoring and Remediation
cases.description: Continuous Compliance Monitoring and Remediation: Compliance agents continuously evaluate infrastructure, applications, and business processes against policies, automatically remediate violations, and generate audit evidence.
cases.rationale: Continuous policy evaluation triggers automatic remediation and evidence generation.

cases.title: Autonomous Network Operations
cases.description: Autonomous Network Operations: Network agents monitor performance and availability, identify outages or latency issues, reroute traffic, optimize configurations, and restore service levels automatically.
cases.rationale: Network state drives automatic routing, configuration, and restoration actions.

cases.title: Predictive Maintenance and Asset Optimization
cases.description: Predictive Maintenance and Asset Optimization: Operations agents continuously analyze telemetry from equipment, predict failures, schedule maintenance, order replacement parts, and optimize asset utilization.
cases.rationale: Continuous telemetry analysis drives predictions and operational actions.

cases.title: Supply Chain Control Tower
cases.description: Supply Chain Control Tower: Autonomous agents monitor inventory, supplier performance, transportation networks, and demand forecasts, then dynamically adjust procurement and logistics decisions.
cases.rationale: An autonomous control loop monitors supply state and dynamically adjusts decisions.

cases.title: FinOps Cost Optimization Platform
cases.description: FinOps Cost Optimization Platform: Financial operations agents continuously monitor cloud spending, identify waste, shut down unused resources, right-size infrastructure, and optimize resource allocation.
cases.rationale: Continuous spend observation drives resource mutations and optimization actions.

cases.title: Autonomous Manufacturing Operations
cases.description: Autonomous Manufacturing Operations: Manufacturing agents monitor production lines, optimize scheduling, detect quality issues, adjust machine settings, and coordinate maintenance activities to maximize yield.
cases.rationale: An autonomous production loop observes quality and adjusts machines and schedules.

cases.title: Real-Time Fraud Prevention System
cases.description: Real-Time Fraud Prevention System: Fraud detection agents analyze transaction streams, evaluate risk signals, suspend suspicious activities, initiate customer verification workflows, and continuously adapt detection strategies.
cases.rationale: Continuous adaptation and conditional suspension make this an autonomous loop despite workflow wording.

cases.title: Enterprise Operations Command Center
cases.description: Enterprise Operations Command Center: A network of autonomous agents monitors business processes, customer experience, infrastructure, security, financial performance, and workforce operations, coordinating actions across systems to maintain predefined business outcomes.
cases.rationale: An explicit network of autonomous agents coordinates actions across business domains.

cases.title: Autonomous Revenue Operations
cases.description: Autonomous Revenue Operations: Agents continuously manage lead qualification, pipeline progression, forecasting, pricing compliance, renewal management, and revenue leakage prevention while coordinating with CRM and ERP systems.
cases.rationale: A continuous autonomous revenue loop coordinates with systems rather than distinct logical agents.

cases.title: Agent-to-Agent Enterprise Knowledge Network
cases.description: Agent-to-Agent Enterprise Knowledge Network: Specialized agents across HR, Finance, IT, Sales, Operations, and Customer Support collaborate continuously to answer questions, execute actions, share context, and optimize enterprise-wide decision making.
cases.rationale: Agent-to-agent wording and six named domains establish a collaborative agent network.

cases.title: Autonomous Transformation Office
cases.description: Autonomous Transformation Office: Strategic planning, execution, risk, communications, financial tracking, and reporting agents coordinate large-scale transformation programs while continuously adjusting plans to achieve target outcomes.
cases.rationale: Six functional agent roles coordinate and continuously adjust a transformation program.

cases.title: Marketing Copy Generation
cases.description: Marketing Copy Generation: A single model call rewrites a supplied product description into three distinct tone variations for a marketing team, using only the text provided in the prompt.
cases.rationale: One stateless generation transforms provided text with no retrieval, tools, or multi-step control.

cases.title: Customer Feedback Sentiment Labeling
cases.description: Customer Feedback Sentiment Labeling: A single model call reads a short snippet of customer feedback text and labels its sentiment as positive, neutral, or negative.
cases.rationale: A one-shot classification over supplied text needs no retrieval, tools, or orchestration.

cases.title: Paragraph Translation
cases.description: Paragraph Translation: A model translates a supplied paragraph of text from English to Spanish and returns only the translated text.
cases.rationale: A single translation call transforms provided text with no additional capabilities.

cases.title: Grounded Policy Question Answering
cases.description: Grounded Policy Question Answering: An assistant answers employee benefits questions through retrieval from an internal HR knowledge base and generates a grounded answer with source citations.
cases.rationale: Retrieval grounds a generated answer without conditional actions, ordered stages, or multiple agents.

cases.title: Documentation Grounded Answering
cases.description: Documentation Grounded Answering: A helpdesk assistant draws relevant sections from the product documentation knowledge base and composes a concise grounded answer for the user.
cases.rationale: Knowledge-base grounding feeds a single generation with no acting, branching, or agent collaboration.

cases.title: Semantic FAQ Grounding
cases.description: Semantic FAQ Grounding: A knowledge assistant uses semantic search over a knowledge base of past answers held in a vector store to find the most relevant entries and generate a grounded response.
cases.rationale: Semantic retrieval over a vector store grounds one generated response with no downstream actions.

cases.title: Ad-Hoc Data Analysis
cases.description: Ad-Hoc Data Analysis: A data analysis assistant receives a dataset and a question, writes and executes Python code in a sandboxed code interpreter to compute the requested statistics, and returns the numeric result.
cases.rationale: A single actor authors and runs code in an interpreter to compute results rather than orchestrating agents.

cases.title: Portfolio Risk Computation
cases.description: Portfolio Risk Computation: A quantitative assistant writes and runs Python code to compute portfolio risk metrics from an uploaded spreadsheet and returns the calculated figures.
cases.rationale: Code generation and execution drive the numeric computation for one requesting user.

cases.title: Statistical Test Computation
cases.description: Statistical Test Computation: A data assistant executes code in a code interpreter to run statistical tests on a CSV file and produces a summary of the computed results.
cases.rationale: One assistant runs code in an interpreter to compute statistics rather than coordinating multiple agents.
